_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.277 organizes SysID into scan setup, run status, measured results and saved runs. PID gains share Kp/Ki/Kd headings, with separate timing/output, feedback and Apply cards. Buttons align and the report grows with content before scrolling.

The complete startup logo now has a small firmware version and stable release date below it. Startup remains one second.

All OLED screens retain a two-pixel guard around every edge. Rounded headers/frames and lower text move inward; long complete labels can use the smaller font. Both transfer paths and the authoritative GUI mirror retain the same inset framebuffer.

Control gains, equations, safety thresholds, calibration, timing and branch-specific presets are unchanged. Default retains its automatic pulse-preservation control; Valinor retains its Max80–220 menu. Independent SysID HIGH repeat disagreement remains rejected and the saved tuning is retained. This release does not claim cross-cuff, pulse-preservation or population qualification.

Validation and protected flash/readback/ten-minute seed-213 soak evidence are archived in gui/recordings/followup280_delivery. Installers use the existing verified branch feed and protected firmware-alignment path.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
